items.title: LASR Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates on Strong A&D Growth
items.summary: nLIGHT's Q2 2026 earnings and revenues beat estimates as record aerospace and defense demand fueles strong product sales and margin gains.

items.title: Gen Digital Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: GEN beats Q1 earnings and revenue estimates, posts double-digit bookings growth, and raises fiscal 2027 guidance as demand stays strong.

items.title: AMSC Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates on Margin Pressure, Sales Beat
items.summary: American Superconductor's Q1 sales rise 30% and beat estimates, but earnings decline 44.8% as Comtrafo costs, labor and product mix pressure margins.

items.title: Sabre Q2 Loss Widens, Revenues Beat Estimates on Marketplace Growth
items.summary: SABR's Q2 revenues rise 4% on Marketplace growth, while its loss widens, and stronger EBITDA and cash flow support a higher 2026 outlook.

items.title: Atlassian Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: TEAM tops Q4 earnings and revenue estimates as subscription, cloud and AI platform growth fuel enterprise momentum and support fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.title: MTSI Q3 Earnings Surpass Expectations, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: MACOM Technology's Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings and revenues beat estimates as broad-based growth, led by data center demand, lifts sales 35.8%.

items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Is Considered a Good Investment by Brokers: Is That True?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Analog Devices (ADI) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: Amdocs Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates as Managed Services Hit Record
items.summary: DOX matches Q3 FY26 earnings estimates as managed services hit record sales and fiscal 2026 targets remain intact.
